about_the_game:
Math Frenzy is a high-energy math arcade game where quick thinking meets fast action. Solve equations in your head, pick the right answer from multiple choices, and race against the clock. The faster you solve, the more points you score — but one mistake can end your run!

Three Game Modes

  • Arcade Mode – Endless rapid-fire questions where every second counts. Build streaks, rack up huge scores, and chase your personal best.

  • Levels Mode – Face handcrafted sets of questions and unique challenges. Earn 1–3 stars based on your performance and try to perfect every stage.

  • Zen Mode – A relaxed, pressure-free way to practice and sharpen your mental math skills at your own pace.

Features

  • 🕹️ Fast-paced gameplay – Quick equations, multiple-choice answers, and rising pressure.

  • ⏱️ Race against the clock – Think fast or risk losing your streak.

  • ⭐ Challenge progression – Master Levels mode and earn up to 3 stars per stage.

  • 📈 Stats tracking – See your accuracy, best streaks, and overall progress over time.

  • 🎯 Replay value – Short sessions, addictive runs, and endless room for improvement.

  • 🎶 Arcade vibe – Bright visuals and retro-inspired sounds keep the energy high.

Whether you’re looking to sharpen your math skills, challenge your reflexes, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade action, Math Frenzy delivers fun that’s easy to pick up but tough to put down.

Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS, Ubuntu 16.04, CentOS 7.2, Debian 9, or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
